reviews.title: Paid image generations shouldn’t be wasted on errors
reviews.text:
I like Character.AI and the new image generation can actually produce some really good images, but the way generation credits are handled needs fixing. I regularly request four images and get one successful image while the other three simply say “Failed to generate image. Please try again.” This is especially frustrating because generations are limited to 20 per day, with the option to pay for more. If someone is spending money on additional generations, failed images should not consume that allowance. A failed generation should either be automatically retried or the credit should be returned. AI producing an image I don’t like is understandable — that’s part of image generation. Paying or using limited credits and receiving no image at all is different. The generator has potential, but I can’t justify rating this higher while a paid/limited feature can repeatedly fail like this. I understand that generative AI costs money to operate. My problem isn’t that generations are limited or monetised; it’s that failed generations can waste that limited resource. If the app returns ‘Failed to generate image,’ that attempt should automatically retry or be refunded.

reviews.title: Severe decline in quality
reviews.text:
I have never known a group of developers so eager to sabotage their own product before I came across Character AI’s state in 2026. 

I have been a long time user of this app, having used it since the original web version in 2023. I have been satisfied with the performance of it up until recently. The decision to remove longstanding features in the form of the various chat styles is, to put it bluntly, foolish. It would have been decently alright if the model they were replacing them with was functional, but it is not. There had been a complete lack of oversight with the quality of responses the bots give you, and there seems to be no quality control with these new updates. The bots have effectively been lobotomised and have no character, and when you use the feature allowing you to generate a different response, they instead generate the exact same response but with the words slightly rearranged. 

Honestly, it’s boring now. The responses are unimaginative and not exciting in the slightest. Roleplaying with Chat GPT would be more interesting. The developers have focused too much on adding features that users have not asked for or expressed any interest in, and have instead neglected the one core feature of the app, being the characters themselves. In its current state, Character AI is just a husk of its former self.
